name: Tiddly-Wink American
description: Tiddly-Wink American is a domino connecting game from the Block game family. Each player is dealt three tiles from a double-six set; play forms a single arm. Playing a double grants an optional second play. The player who dominoes wins the pool, or the lowest pip count wins if blocked.
